commands.name: issue list
commands.description: List issues in a project (filters are ANDed; comma lists mean "any of")

options.name: parent
options.description: children of this issue, or none for top-level issues

options.name: search
options.description: text in key, title or description

options.name: where
options.description: any filter, e.g. priority.gte=2, dueDate.isNull=true, cf.severity=high

options.name: includeDeleted
options.description: include issues in the trash (only in projects you can write in; ignored elsewhere)

commands.name: issue view
commands.description: Show one issue

commands.name: issue create
commands.description: Create an issue (prints the new issue; -q prints only its key)

options.name: bodyFile
options.description: read the description from a file, or - for stdin

options.name: assignee
options.description: handle, @handle, me, or none to unassign

options.name: repo
options.description: one of the project's linked GitHub repos (owner/name, URL or id); none, null or '' clears it

options.name: input
options.description: full JSON payload (CreateIssueInput / UpdateIssueInput); flags override it

commands.name: issue edit
commands.description: Edit one or more issues (several issues are updated atomically)

options.name: bodyFile
options.description: read the description from a file, or - for stdin

options.name: assignee
options.description: handle, @handle, me, or none to unassign

options.name: repo
options.description: one of the project's linked GitHub repos (owner/name, URL or id); none, null or '' clears it

options.name: input
options.description: full JSON payload (CreateIssueInput / UpdateIssueInput); flags override it

options.name: ifVersion
options.description: fail with exit 4 unless the issue is at this version

commands.name: issue move
commands.description: Move an issue on the board: change status and/or position within the column

options.name: top
options.description: place at the top of the column (default)

options.name: bottom
options.description: place at the bottom of the column

options.name: ifVersion
options.description: fail unless the issue is at this version

commands.name: issue delete
commands.description: Move an issue to the trash (restorable); --permanent deletes for good (admin)

options.name: permanent
options.description: delete permanently, with comments and links

options.name: ifVersion
options.description: fail unless the issue is at this version

commands.name: issue restore
commands.description: Restore an issue from the trash

commands.name: issue children
commands.description: List sub-issues

commands.name: issue activity
commands.description: Show the history of an issue (changes, comments, links)

options.name: after
options.description: only events after this sequence number

commands.name: comment list
commands.description: List comments on an issue (oldest first)

commands.name: comment add
commands.description: Comment on an issue (markdown)

options.name: bodyFile
options.description: read the text from a file, or - for stdin

commands.name: comment edit
commands.description: Edit your comment

options.name: bodyFile
options.description: read the text from a file, or - for stdin

commands.name: comment delete
commands.description: Delete your comment

commands.name: link list
commands.description: List an issue's links from its perspective

commands.name: link add
commands.description: Link two issues, e.g. `link add ENG-1 blocks ENG-2` or `link add ENG-2 blocked-by ENG-1`

arguments.name: relation
arguments.description: link type key or alias (blocks, blocked-by, is-blocked-by, relates, relates-to, duplicates, duplicated-by, is-duplicated-by)

commands.name: link remove
commands.description: Remove a link by id (see `link list`)

commands.name: link types
commands.description: List link types

commands.name: attachment add
commands.description: Upload one or more files to an issue (the media type is detected from the content)

arguments.name: files
arguments.description: paths to upload, or - for stdin (with --name)

options.name: name
options.description: filename to store (default: the file’s basename)

options.name: comment
options.description: associate the upload with a comment on the issue

commands.name: attachment list
commands.description: List the files attached to an issue

commands.name: attachment view
commands.description: Show an attachment’s metadata

commands.name: attachment download
commands.description: Download an attachment’s content to a file (default: its filename) or - for stdout

options.name: output
options.description: where to write it; - writes the bytes to stdout

commands.name: attachment remove
commands.description: Delete an attachment (uploader or admin)

commands.name: project list
commands.description: List projects

commands.name: project view
commands.description: Show a project

arguments.name: project
arguments.description: project key or id (default: configured project)

commands.name: project create
commands.description: Create a project with the default workflow (admin)

options.name: visibility
options.description: public: anyone can read; private (default): members and admins

commands.name: project edit
commands.description: Edit a project

options.name: visibility
options.description: public: anyone can read; private: members and admins

commands.name: project schema
commands.description: JSON Schema for issue create/update in this project, with live enums (statuses, labels, repos, assignable users, custom fields)

commands.name: project members list
commands.description: List the project members

commands.name: project members add
commands.description: Give a user a role on the project (needs manage)

options.name: role
options.description: viewer reads, editor also writes, manager also manages the project

commands.name: project members set
commands.description: Change a member's role (needs manage)

commands.name: project members remove
commands.description: Remove a user's role on the project (needs manage)

commands.name: project repo list
commands.description: List the linked repositories

commands.name: project repo add
commands.description: Link a GitHub repository to the project (needs manage)

commands.name: project repo remove
commands.description: Unlink a repository (needs manage); issues that named it are cleared. Takes owner/name, a URL or an rpo_ id

arguments.name: repo
arguments.description: owner/name, github.com URL or repo id

commands.name: status list
commands.description: List statuses in board order

commands.name: status create
commands.description: Create a status

commands.name: status edit
commands.description: Edit a status

commands.name: status delete
commands.description: Delete a status (use --move-to if issues use it)

options.name: moveTo
options.description: move its issues to this status first

commands.name: status reorder
commands.description: Set the column order: list every status, in order

commands.name: label list
commands.description: List labels

commands.name: label create
commands.description: Create a label

commands.name: label edit
commands.description: Edit a label

commands.name: label delete
commands.description: Delete a label (removes it from issues)

commands.name: field list
commands.description: List custom fields

commands.name: field create
commands.description: Create a custom field, e.g. `field create severity --type select --option low,high`

options.name: option
options.description: options for select types (repeatable or comma-separated)

commands.name: field edit
commands.description: Rename, describe, reorder or (un)archive a field

commands.name: field delete
commands.description: Delete a field and all its values permanently (admin; prefer `field edit --archive`)

commands.name: field option-add
commands.description: Add options to a select / multi_select field

commands.name: field option-edit
commands.description: Relabel, recolor or (un)archive an option

options.name: archive
options.description: archive (cannot be chosen anymore; existing values stay)

commands.name: view list
commands.description: List views (shared + yours)

commands.name: view show
commands.description: Show a view including its config

commands.name: view create
commands.description: Save a view

commands.name: view edit
commands.description: Rename a view or replace its config

commands.name: view delete
commands.description: Delete a view

commands.name: event list
commands.description: List events after a sequence number (use the last seq you saw as --after)

options.name: issue
options.description: only this issue (use the global --project to filter by project)

commands.name: event tail
commands.description: Follow new events as NDJSON (one event per line) until interrupted

options.name: issue
options.description: only this issue (use the global --project to filter by project)

commands.name: webhook list
commands.description: List webhooks

commands.name: webhook create
commands.description: Register a webhook; prints its signing secret (shown only now)

commands.name: webhook view
commands.description: Show a webhook

commands.name: webhook edit
commands.description: Change a webhook; --enable re-activates an automatically disabled one

options.name: scope
options.description: only events from this project; `all` removes the scope

commands.name: webhook delete
commands.description: Delete a webhook and its delivery log

commands.name: webhook rotate-secret
commands.description: Replace the signing secret; prints the new one

commands.name: webhook test
commands.description: Send a signed webhook.ping now and show the answer (exit 6 unless it was 2xx)

commands.name: webhook deliveries
commands.description: Show recent deliveries, newest first

commands.name: webhook redeliver
commands.description: Send a delivery again (with a fresh set of retries)

commands.name: user list
commands.description: List users

commands.name: user view
commands.description: Show a user

commands.name: user create
commands.description: Create a user (admin). Give every agent its own user so its work is attributed.

commands.name: user edit
commands.description: Edit a user

commands.name: auth login
commands.description: Store an API token for a server (verifies it first): auth login --server <url> --token <t> | --with-token

commands.name: auth logout
commands.description: Forget the stored token for the server (--server or the current default)

commands.name: auth status
commands.description: Show how the CLI connects and who it acts as

commands.name: whoami
commands.description: Show the user the CLI acts as

commands.name: init
commands.description: Write .poietic-issues.json here from the global --server/--database, --project and --actor (never tokens)

commands.name: db migrate
commands.description: Apply pending migrations

options.name: down
options.description: revert the newest applied migration instead (one step; drops its tables and columns, so back up first; never reverts the first migration)

commands.name: db status
commands.description: Show applied and pending migrations

commands.name: db bootstrap
commands.description: Create the first admin of a fresh installation (migrating if needed)

commands.name: db seed
commands.description: Create demo users (ada admin, grace, margaret, claude agent), public ENG with a linked repo, private OPS and sample issues

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Run the tracker server (API + web app if built) on the local database

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Print a JSON Schema: resources and inputs (use `project schema` for live per-project enums)

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: one of: issue, issue-create, issue-update, issue-move, issue-filter, comment, comment-create, link, link-create, project, project-create, view-create, view-config, event, problem

commands.name: api
commands.description: Call any API endpoint directly and print the JSON response (like `gh api`)

options.name: field
options.description: body field (repeatable; values parsed as JSON when possible)

commands.name: commands
commands.description: Describe every command, option, exit code and error code (use --json for agents)

globalOptions.name: actor
globalOptions.description: local mode: act as this user

globalOptions.name: fields
globalOptions.description: comma-separated fields to include, e.g. key,title,status

exitCodes.2: Usage or validation error (bad flags, invalid input, invalid relation)

environment.POIETIC_AGENT_TOKEN: Remote mode: act as this poietic.tech agent (takes precedence over POIETIC_ISSUES_TOKEN)
environment.POIETIC_ISSUES_ACTOR: Local mode: user handle to act as
